name: Vanar Generation 1
summary: A Mumbai garage-shop attempt at India's first general-purpose humanoid, founded by Aryan Wagh in 2024. The prototype is still partial — one arm, half a torso, a head frame — and the target is a body that lifts, carries, cleans and inspects using existing human tools, priced, the company says, like a motorcycle.

sources.title: Meet India's 5'9", 50-kg humanoid designed by a Mumbai-based startup — Startup Pedia
